findings.title: CronJob's schedule never comes due
findings.cause: CronJob billing's schedule "0 0 30 2 *" never comes due: day 30 of month 2 does not exist, so the controller finds no next run and starts no Job (InvalidSchedule)

evidence.detail: invalid schedule: 0 0 30 2 * : time difference between two schedules is less than 1 second

evidence.command: kubectl get cronjob billing -n kd-cronjob-never-due -o jsonpath='{.spec.schedule}{" "}{.status.lastScheduleTime}'

findings.fix: Write a schedule for a day the intended months have: day 28 or earlier runs every month. For the last day of the month, schedule days 28-31 and have the job exit unless tomorrow is the 1st; Kubernetes cron has no L for last day.
